## About
Auto Renew LLC. is an auto body shop at 8615 W Kelton Ln in Peoria, run by owner Eric Allen. We do collision repair, bumper and panel repair and paint, paint touch-ups, paintless dent removal and scratch removal.
It's not the biggest shop around, and one reviewer admitted that made him a little leery at first. What people tend to write about is working with Eric directly: he does what he says and keeps you in the loop. Customers rate us 4.8 from 23 Google reviews.
If you've had an accident, we work with your insurance company to keep the repair moving. Call the office or send us a description of the damage to get started.

## Services
- Collision repair: Body, structural and refinish work after an accident, with the goal of making a rough experience as easy as we can.
- Bumper repair & paint: Repairs and paint for damaged bumpers. One reviewer had a plastic bumper repaired along with a repainted hood and fender, and said the gloss was so deep he could see the moon reflect in it.
- Paintless dent removal: For dents where the paint is still intact, we work the metal back from behind using specialized tools and lighting, no repainting needed. Dents on an edge or corner, or small deep dents, usually aren't a fit.
- Scratch repair: Light scratches are sanded, buffed and waxed. Deeper scratches that reach the primer or metal often need repainting, and can still be completed within one day.

## FAQ
Q: How much will my dent repair cost?
A: Every dent is different in size, location and access, so it's hard to quote over the phone. Call us or email a picture with a description of the dent and we'll give you an idea of the cost.

Q: Can paintless dent removal fix my dent?
A: It works best when the paint is intact and the dent isn't on an edge or corner of the panel. Small, deep dents usually can't be removed this way.

Q: Can I reach you after hours?
A: Yes. Outside office hours you can call our after hours line at 623-680-7217.
